candidates.title: Fleet: Hierarchical Task-based Abstraction for Megakernels on Multi-Die GPUs
candidates.reason: multi-die GPUのprivate cache hierarchyをflat CUDA/HIP execution modelが表現できない問題に対し、chiplet-taskとpersistent-kernel runtimeでper-chiplet locality/schedulingを導入。MI350/Qwen3-8Bでdecode latency 1.3-1.5x改善、HBM traffic最大37%削減を報告し、memory hierarchyとruntime co-designとして有用。

candidates.title: Fine-grained Computation-Communication Overlap via Tile-level Signaling and Scheduling for Mixture-of-Experts
candidates.reason: MoE expert computeとreturn all-to-allをtile-level ready signalingで重畳し、persistent compute/communication kernelを別SM partitionで並行実行する。粗粒度collectiveやmonolithic fusionとは異なるfine-grained overlap設計で、distributed MoE runtime系統を補完する。
